name.description: Name of C3 Environment unique in the parent Cluster

tags.description: Tags that serve as arbitrary metadata attached to the object of a type

singleNode.description:
If true then this environment will only have a single node that will serve requests and execute jobs for every
App in this Env

minimalInfra.description: Start Env with a minimal infrastructure

defaultAppMode.description: Default app mode to optionally define {@link App#mode}.

allowTestToProd.description: Allow Apps in this env to change mode from Test to Prod, as an exception.

sharedDb.description: Only applicable for cases where Env is a singleNode Env. This flag controls whether the env will use shared instances for {@link JdbcStore} and {@link KvStore} or use a H2 disk-backed datastore for both.
